agents.note: demo() creates future_analyst and strategic_planner through AgentOrchestrator; the orchestrator can create additional agents dynamically.

tools.note: Per-agent thinking tools are generated according to ThinkingMode.

mcp.note: core/mcp_config.json exists but core/agents_system.py does not bind MCP into the reviewed Agents SDK principals.

authority.fact: AgentOrchestrator dynamically constructs OpenAI Agents SDK Agent instances and stores them by name.
Generated thinking tools return local analytical data structures and do not perform privileged I/O.
The reviewed agent system has no tool handoffs or MCP authority despite adjacent MCP code/config elsewhere in the repository.

forbidden_expectations.reason: Reviewed thinking tools do not execute processes.
Reviewed thinking tools do not mutate external/application state.
No MCP server is bound to the reviewed Agents SDK principals.

unresolved: Other repository subsystems contain many MCP/server implementations, but source linkage from those systems to core/agents_system.py is not established in the reviewed path.
